observations.posthog_connection: Reduces unnecessary full-refresh behavior when metadata permits, potentially improving warehouse sync efficiency.

observations.behavior: Tests that declared primary keys do not exceed available CSV headers, preventing merge failures.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks correctness of warehouse ingestion configuration before deployment.

observations.limitations: All hunks reside in a single Cody-specific warehouse source. No broader PostHog system changes, shared dependencies, or tier-3 systemic improvements are demonstrated.

review.limitations: All hunks reside in a single Cody-specific warehouse source. No broader PostHog system changes, shared dependencies, or tier-3 systemic improvements are demonstrated.
review.reason: Adds bounded capability: the Cody warehouse connector now supports primary-key-based incremental refreshes rather than always doing full replacement. This is visible through P1.F4 (primary_key field added), P1.F3 (frozen config and conditional usage) and P1.F5 (tests). The benefit is reliability and potential performance improvement for warehouse users; it does not demonstrate cross-component reach or risk reduction sufficient for tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to warehouse ingestion and data integrity. Users relying on this connector could benefit from reduced redundant loads if column documentation becomes complete.
review.uncertainty: Only one vendor implementation shown; no tests or production behavior outside Cody path.
